# PicHarbor unified gpmc source

Original gpmc code: xob0t/gpmc, MIT; see _licenses/GPMC-MIT.txt.
PicHarbor integrations were consolidated from the desktop, iOS and Android repositories
on 2026-11-12. See the canonical repository docs/integration-sources.json and
INTEGRATION-LOG.md for the actual source revisions and preservation decisions.
The imported PicHarbor protocol, deadline and access adapters retain the source
project GPL-3.0 terms; see _licenses/PICHARBOR-GPL-3.0.txt. Do not describe the
combined distribution as entirely MIT. Original MIT notices remain applicable.
Live Photo wire references: xob0t/gotohp @ 97a5dc0 and
g8row/PhotosBackup @ 3c88269. Reference license: _licenses/LIVE-PAIR-REFERENCE-MIT.txt.
Live Photo pairing remains experimental, not certified cloud/device acceptance.
Platform UI, media permissions, application orchestration and credentials stay
in the consumers. No client downloads this package at runtime.
